Amentum provides software and systems engineering support for Naval projects and contributes to modernizing Navy weapons and sensor systems. The Simulink Software Developer will perform modeling for Naval and SLBM weapon-system programs, support a senior developer using Agile principles, and conduct analysis and problem-solving within collaborative, schedule-driven engineering teams.
Mechanical Engineering
Security
Technical Support
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Perform **Simulink modeling** in support of Naval projects and programs
Conduct modeling within the **Submarine Launched Ballistic Missile (SLBM) weapon system**
Primarily support a Senior Amentum developer in development using **Agile development principles**
Apply Simulink experience and familiarity with Agile Development in support of project requirements
Perform analysis and problem-solving techniques in support of professional scientific and engineering work
Work independently and with others within established teams and across organizations to meet established goals within schedule-driven timelines

Must have an active Secret U.S. Government clearance. U.S. citizenship is required to maintain a Secret clearance
Candidate must maintain a valid REAL ID driver's license, required for access to the customer site, and have access to reliable transportation, as this position requires occasional travel between local work sites during the week
